entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Top down analysis starting from the top working our way down.
entry_sequence.action: Begin the top-down analysis by starting at the highest timeframe (e.g., Monthly).
entry_sequence.rationale: This establishes the overall market bias and structure.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: We're trying to capture as many touch points as possible.
entry_sequence.action: Draw both upward and downward trend lines, capturing as many touch points as possible.
entry_sequence.rationale: Trend lines provide the structural guidance for the market movement.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Remember, we're going to make sure that price does not intersect.
entry_sequence.action: Ensure that the price does not intersect or cut through the trend lines while drawing them.
entry_sequence.rationale: The integrity of the trend line is maintained only if price respects the line.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: All of the lines that we draw from higher time frames down to lower time frames have to connect.
entry_sequence.action: Iteratively move down through timeframes (e.g., Monthly to Weekly, Weekly to Daily, etc.), ensuring each new trend line connects to the previous line's most recent touch point.
entry_sequence.rationale: Connecting lines maintains structural integrity across different time scales.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break one of the established trend lines (the 'action line').
entry_sequence.rationale: The break of a trend line serves as the primary indication to enter a trade.
